functions.name: code_refactor
functions.description: Refactors, rewrites, or fixes code in a specific workspace file. Used when the user asks JACO to change or update their code.

filePath.description: The relative path to the file to modify in the JACO workspace.

instruction.description: The instructions describing what to change or refactor.

newContent.description: The completely rewritten file content based on the instruction.

functions.name: quality_audit
functions.description: Performs a deep quality audit on a specific file or the whole workspace, checking for type safety, complexity, and Android AppFunctions compliance.

targetPath.description: The path to audit. Leave empty to audit the entire workspace.

functions.name: git_ops
functions.description: Executes Git operations like commit, checkout, branch creation, or status checks.

args.description: Additional arguments for the git command, e.g. commit message.
